question: For veg whsle data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? Include the average loss rate, and also break down the count of items that are below, above, and within one standard deviation from this average.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss,
    STDDEV("loss_rate_%") AS stddev_loss
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
)
SELECT
  ROUND(s.avg_loss, 2) AS avg_loss,
  ROUND(s.stddev_loss, 2) AS stddev_loss,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" < s.avg_loss - s.stddev_loss THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_1sd,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" > s.avg_loss + s.stddev_loss THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_1sd,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" >= s.avg_loss - s.stddev_loss
           AND v."loss_rate_%" <= s.avg_loss + s.stddev_loss THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_1sd
FROM veg_loss_rate_df v, stats s
GROUP BY s.avg_loss, s.stddev_loss
